_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); chemical and refining signals

pit_profile.why: Risk factor (FY2023 10-K): Our business operations are subject to the cyclical and volatile nature of the supply-demand balance in the chemical and refining industries.; of the other live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': none names chemicals or refining, and the FY2023 10-K names no cloud, offshore delivery, e-commerce, streaming, electric vehicles, crypto, generative AI, or GLP-1 drugs; EV's 'auto parts suppliers' and 'fuel retail' name no LyondellBasell business: its 10-Ks say its products go into 'automotive components' among many uses, and its Houston refinery's refined products are ENERGY_TRANSITION's refining; ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12): the Refining segment refines crude oil and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for LyondellBasell

theme_watch.reason: Live: LyondellBasell's own FY2023 10-K says 'Refining. Our Refining segment refines heavy, high-sulfur crude oil and other crude oils of varied types and sources available on the U.S. Gulf Coast into refined products, including gasoline and distillates.' and, of greenhouse gas laws and regulations, 'Additional regulations could be forthcoming at the U.S. federal or state level that could result in increased operating costs for compliance, required acquisition or trading of emission allowances, or compliance costs associated with additional regulatory frameworks for a range of potential carbon reduction projects, including carbon capture, use, and sequestration projects. Additionally, demand for the products we produce may be reduced.' The stock trades at 13.4x FY24E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ENERGY_TRANSITION) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing decarbonisation of LyondellBasell's refining and the demand for its products specifically.

BEAR.desc: EPS -55.7%/yr (worst year FY14-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +2.4%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +2.4%/yr (FY14-FY23 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +66.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2024-11-01) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 10.56x (90.8% downside to Bear $8 / +8.6% upside to Bull $94) | Adj composite 1.67 vs market 2.86: gap -1.19 [OVERVALUED] | +91% above the EPP floor $45 (7x FY24E $6.48) | Conservative 2-yr case: -19.3% total (-9.6%/yr) | At 13.4x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $114 sits above the BULL case; O&P–Americas +82.8% and Intermediates & Derivatives -65.6% operating income in Q3 2024, forward revenues -2.9% (no FY24 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2024 revenues as reported); the energy transition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
